# Get All Alarms

iOS 14 +

## Notes

Retrieves all of your alarms.

## Syntax

~~~~text
getallalarms(show: <#Boolean (Optional)#>)
~~~~

## Example

~~~~text
getallalarms(show: false)
~~~~
